src = open('common_utils.py').read()
old = '''        # Router incidence tables: node ids that actually route (the external
        # sentinel is not a router).
        self.router_ids = sorted({n for f in self.flows for n in f.routers})
        self.router_of = {nid: r for r, nid in enumerate(self.router_ids)}
        self.router_flows = [[] for _ in self.router_ids]
        self.router_signs = [[] for _ in self.router_ids]
        self.flow_slots = [[] for _ in self.flows]
        for r, nid in enumerate(self.router_ids):
            for f in self.flows:
                if nid not in f.routers:
                    continue
                pos = len(self.router_flows[r])
                self.router_flows[r].append(f.index)
                sign = 1 if f.src == nid else -1
                self.router_signs[r].append(sign)
                self.flow_slots[f.index].append((r, pos))
        for r in range(len(self.router_ids)):
            self.router_flows[r] = tuple(self.router_flows[r])
            self.router_signs[r] = tuple(self.router_signs[r])
        self.flow_slots = [tuple(slots) for slots in self.flow_slots]'''
new = '''        # Router incidence tables: node ids that actually route (the external
        # sentinel is not a router).  Canonical flow order keeps every router's
        # incidence list canonical without a second sort.
        self.router_ids = sorted({n for f in self.flows for n in f.routers})
        self.router_of = {nid: r for r, nid in enumerate(self.router_ids)}
        buckets = {r: [] for r in range(len(self.router_ids))}
        self.flow_slots = [[] for _ in self.flows]
        for flow in self.flows:
            for nid in flow.routers:
                r = self.router_of[nid]
                pos = len(buckets[r])
                buckets[r].append((flow.index, 1 if flow.src == nid else -1))
                flow_slots = self.flow_slots[flow.index]
                flow_slots.append((r, pos))
        self.router_flows = [tuple(fi for fi, _ in buckets[r])
                             for r in range(len(self.router_ids))]
        self.router_signs = [tuple(s for _, s in buckets[r])
                             for r in range(len(self.router_ids))]
        self.flow_slots = [tuple(slots) for slots in self.flow_slots]'''
assert old in src
open('common_utils.py','w').write(src.replace(old, new))
